_comment: User-editable budget knobs. Dungeon economics (energyCost, maxRoom, maxRunsPerDay) come from config/discovered.json (generated, gitignored) — this file only holds the numbers a human chooses. Session-08: conservative first-session budget, 3 runs at 20 energy each per session-08 brief §5. Session-09: raised to 120/5 per session-09 brief's explicit stated budget ('120 energy this session... covers five runs with margin') for Task 6's five-run stage — the guard-persistence fix landed this session made maxRunsPerSession a REAL cap across process invocations for the first time, and it was still holding at the session-08 conservative value, capping the session at 3 runs before the five-run gate could be attempted. Session-11: raised to 240/12, matching the user's own confirmed REAL daily budget (session-11 brief §6: '240 energy/day dungeon budget, 12 runs at 20 energy') rather than a session-scoped guess — the guard is date-keyed, so this is now a standing calibration to reality, not a one-day bump. Confirmed directly by the user this session (not raised unilaterally) after today's 78/5 spend from sessions 09-10 blocked the session-11 brief's ask of 3 more 20-energy runs. See DECISIONS.md.

potions._comment: Session 17: explicit user authorization, required before the live loop uses ANY potion — user flagged that an unguarded auto-detect-from-inventory default could burn through a limited/valuable consumable without real intent. allowedItemId 131 = Big Heal Juice (the only potion type the bot is authorized to touch). maxPerRun 2, user's own choice this session (not the theoretical hard-cap-of-3 from DECISIONS.md 2026-08-15) — matches what was actually live-tested twice in session 16, leaves 1 in reserve against the current 3-unit stock. Change or remove this block to adjust; removing it disables automatic potion use entirely.

dendren._comment: Session 13, Task 9's first live fishing budget: 100/5, conservative-first-session posture, session-13 comment retained below for history. Session 15: raised to 200/15 per the session-15 brief's direct instruction ('start live fishing casts early... the user reports 15 casts available today; raise the fishing session cap') — mineFishPatterns.ts (Task 11) needs real transition volume and the daily guard resets, so today's own allowance should actually be used rather than left idle at the old 5-cast conservative figure. 200 energy covers 16 tier-1 casts (12 energy each) with margin over the requested 15; config/discovered.json's maxCastsPerDay (10, non-juiced) is the GAME's own inferred cap and is untested past 5 casts/day — if the live loop hits a real server-side cap below 15, it fails closed (CLAUDE.md §5) rather than guessing past it. Original session-13 note: maxCastsPerSession set conservatively at 5 to match Task 9's staged gate (dry-run, one cast, then five) rather than the game's own maxCastsPerDay cap — same conservative-first-session posture as forbiddenWoods' original 3-run figure (session 08). Tier-1 casts (12 energy, the free tier — SPEC-fishing.md §3) are what the live loop uses unless told otherwise. [VERIFY] whether this energy is the SAME account-wide pool forbiddenWoods spends from — plausible but not confirmed by a captured fishing energy delta yet.
